correctness.rationale: With hub fibers each of size h=min(k,n), each degree-two neighbor has a two-choice fiber and the hubs are nonadjacent. Ordinary lists: equal hub color if lists intersect; otherwise each leaf list forbids <=1 ordered pair. A complete h-by-h grid needs h² leaves. DP matching: two leaf choices fail only if separately blocked by different hub choices, forbidding <=2 coordinate-disjoint ordered pairs; concatenated cyclic perfect matchings partition the grid into ceil(h²/2) such admissible blocks. Explicit local cover gadgets exclude each block and establish necessity. h=n satisfies both inequalities for n>=3; boundary K2,2 twisted DP C4 cover and K2,1 forced-color obstruction are valid. Independent script constructed 510 sample block cases for h=2..14 and confirmed exactly two coordinate-disjoint forbidden hub pairs.
